title: Website AI Assistant (SiteBot)
summary: Embeddable site chatbot that answers from the business’s own docs, cites sources, and captures leads when it cannot help.
problem: Small business sites get the same questions repeatedly, but owners cannot staff live chat around the clock—and generic bots often invent answers.
solution: Built SiteBot: ingest Markdown/PDF/HTML into a retrieval index, answer with citations (offline search by default, optional OpenAI-compatible LLM), show an honest “I don’t know” plus lead capture, and embed with one script tag. Includes admin for conversations, leads, and re-indexing.
